Flow.description: FQS Donor Grouping Configurator — skeleton deployed via metadata. Open in Flow Builder to add: (1) DropdownBox or Radio button for tier selection, (2) Get Records on FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt filtered by Grouping_Key__c, (3) Input fields for Branded_Name__c, One_Time_Min_Amount__c, Annual_Min_Amount__c, Lifetime_Min_Amount__c, (4) Update Custom Metadata action pointing to the loaded record.
Flow.label: FQS Donor Grouping Configurator

fields.name: DisplayText_Instructions
fields.fieldText:
FQS Donor Grouping Configurator

This flow skeleton was deployed via metadata. Open it in Flow Builder to complete the configuration: add tier selection, Get Records on FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt, input fields for thresholds, and an Update Custom Metadata action.

To update thresholds manually, go to Setup > Custom Metadata Types > FQS Donor Grouping > Manage Records.
